source_evidence: You can verify the registration of both publicly traded and non-traded REITs through the SEC’s EDGAR system. You can also use EDGAR to review a REIT’s annual and quarterly reports as well as any offering prospectus.
answer: EDGAR is a resource for researching a REIT’s filings. You can use it to check whether a publicly traded or non-traded REIT is registered with the SEC, and to review the REIT’s annual reports, quarterly reports, and offering prospectus. These materials can help you learn more about the REIT before making an investment decision.
